Hi Samir,

Noticed your usage spiked ~40% over the last two months — congrats on the traction. Your current subscription cycles to 2027-02-28, but with sustained growth it looks like you'll exceed the committed tokens in the next billing period.

Attached is a short uplift proposal with two paths: a mid-contract uplift (adds capacity now, prorated) or co-terming to align everything on Jan 31, 2027 with a single renewal. High level:
- Uplift: add 50% capacity, prorated for remainder of current term
- Co-term: shift renewal date to Jan 31 2027, combine uplift into the next annual term

Do either of those work for your procurement team? Would you be free for a 20-min sync next week to pick a path? I've attached the first draft proposal for numbers.
